scope: A curated starter library, not every PDF on the internet. Source texts are literature and philosophy, not clinical advice.
readingNotes: Mood-to-story links are editorial suggestions, not psychological diagnoses or evidence of treatment efficacy.
Hinglish reflections should be labelled original interpretations, not literal translations.
The Mahabharata Ashtavakra story and the Ashtavakra Gita are different works.
Older translations include dated disability, caste and gender language. Readers may skip any passage.
Original Gita metaphysics about the body and world should not be presented as medical facts or prompts to ignore distress.
